welcomeDiary.title: Welcome to Selume · Your first entry
welcomeDiary.intro: Hello! This entry is a short guide and a space you can freely edit. You do not need to write a lot every day: a small moment, a feeling, or a photo is worth keeping. The text and image below are real examples of what the editor can do.
welcomeDiary.writingInstructions: Tap the edit button at the top right to change this entry. Select text and use the toolbar to make it bold or italic. The heading button offers normal text and three heading levels. Scroll the toolbar sideways to find lists, block quotes, and tables.
welcomeDiary.boldExample: Make a moment worth remembering stand out.
welcomeDiary.italicExample: Leave a little room for quieter feelings, too.
welcomeDiary.quoteExample: Every day does not have to be remarkable. An honest record is enough.
welcomeDiary.syntaxInstructions: Prefer typing? At the start of a line, type ##, -, or > followed by a space to create a heading, a list, or a block quote. Here are some examples:
welcomeDiary.syntaxExample:
## An afternoon moment
- Have a cup of tea
> It is all right to take your time
welcomeDiary.tagsInstructions: Type #Getting-started/Example in the body, then press Space or Enter to create a tag. You can also tap + in the tag row below the title. A slash creates a hierarchy: Example sits inside Getting-started. Try tapping this tag:
welcomeDiary.tagsNavigation: Tap a tag in the body to return to the home page with matching entries, or choose a tag from the home sidebar. Hashes in headings and code stay as text and do not create tags automatically.
welcomeDiary.imagesInstructions: While editing, tap the image button in the toolbar to choose a photo from your device. Images can sit between paragraphs. Tap an image to view it larger, or use its size button to adjust the display width.
welcomeDiary.imageAlt: A peaceful afternoon with a cup of tea and a blank notebook beside a window
welcomeDiary.imageCaption: A peaceful afternoon with a cup of tea and a blank notebook beside a window. This is an artificially generated example image; you can replace it with your own photo.
welcomeDiary.linksCreate: First, create another entry about a moment from today. Then return here and start editing.
welcomeDiary.linksInsert: Tap the diary link button in the toolbar, or type [[, then enter a keyword from that entry's title or body and choose a result.
welcomeDiary.linksExplore: Tap the inserted link to open the entry. Outgoing links and backlinks appear below the body, making it easy to revisit connected memories.
welcomeDiary.detailsMood: While editing, adjust the date, time, and mood below the title to capture how the day felt.
welcomeDiary.detailsTools: The toolbar also supports task lists, audio, and video. For longer entries, use the outline button to jump between headings.
welcomeDiary.taskWrite: Write down one thing you want to remember about today
welcomeDiary.taskPhoto: Add a photo of your own and a tag
welcomeDiary.saving: Changes save automatically while you edit, and the save status appears at the top. Tap the checkmark at the top right to save and return to reading. You can rewrite this example or delete it like any other entry.
welcomeDiary.closing: There is no need to learn every feature at once. Start with one sentence and leave the rest for the days ahead.
